formatPolicy.apscLensOnFullFrame: APS-C/Super35 crop conditions; preserve actual focal length. No automatic equivalent into focal.

Full-frame constant F2.8 zoom; existing legacy facts/new evidence/null fill

readiness.decision: Use user section14 safe branch: finish inventory and compatibility analysis only; do not create production raw/batch/approval/apply or workaround guards.

blockers.facts: All36 legacy lenses omit model; staging requires model. Existing identity lock rejects adding model. Sony lens identity-map entries0.
blockers.scopeForFix: Explicit reviewed missing-model-only identity metadata enrichment for Sony existing6; stable ID/name/aliases/facts preserved. No blanket bypass or mass editing.

blockers.facts: Missing focal rawUnit, string aperture and string OSS pass validate but strict approval rejects. Fixed-body focal helper is not interchangeable-lens guard.
blockers.scopeForFix: Share canonical lens value contract with validate, generalize strict unit checks to lens focal/filter/focus/weight where needed, preserve dimensionless f-number; regression invalid types/ranges/units and legacy replay.

blockers.facts: No typed lens format coverage field; mount string alone cannot represent APS-C/FE crop.
blockers.scopeForFix: Decide narrow optional lens-only coverage contract or explicit non-runtime conditions limitation before APS-C promotion. Do not create separate FE mount or silently claim consumer crop support.

readiness.unsupportedPolicy: Keep official observations in inventory and future claim conditions only; do not reuse body dimensions/IBIS or invent canonical fields.
